scope: Numeric text parsing. FPM 0.12 rejects the upstream features/profiles tables; a checksum-guarded manifest adaptation removes them and supplies the intended -fno-range-check compiler setting explicitly. The Fortran sources are unchanged and development-only benchmark dependencies are not built. The main checks decimal/scientific and Fortran D-exponent parsing, the largest positive signed int64, hexadecimal parsing, invalid-input status and exponent-overflow status. Correct rounding for every input, all formats, underflow, platforms and speed claims are not validated.
compatibility_edits: Remove unsupported features/profiles manifest tables for FPM 0.12 and supply -fno-range-check explicitly. Mathematical sources unchanged.
